output.reason: The linked PR [ev-bfaad53f61ab] says what the one-line changelog entry [ev-e0c05f8fedac] leaves out. Before this change, the query frontend retried any subquery that failed with a 5xx status immediately, and by default it made 5 attempts in total before failing the query. [ev-a085165fe32a] says the PR adds a simple exponential backoff between those retries, so fast-failing queries no longer use up all their attempts within a second. It also makes retries of queries that cause querier out-of-memory crashes less aggressive. The only changed code file is the query frontend's retry logic, pkg/querier/queryrange/queryrangebase/retry.go [ev-53f233b885bc]. Together this supports the open applicability aspect: exposed environments are those running the query frontend with subquery retries enabled, which the PR says is the default (5 attempts). No other gating condition is mentioned.
